scope: One initialized active turn in an exact continuity ledger; one pending RPC at a time
steering: Observe outbound turn/steer; do not apply until matching successful response; append exact single text input as ARE revision. Original RPC stays unchanged.
compaction: Map item/completed contextCompaction to ContextRestore; ignore legacy thread/compacted; never ingest summary.
injection: Generate thread/inject_items request with bounded recovered developer context; no transport in this module.
acceptance: Matching empty injection response means host-accepted, never model-observed.
races: Completion or state changes during pending steering or injection require reconciliation; bridge poisons on ambiguous effects.
restart: No transparent restart for in-flight RPCs; external reconciliation required
